text: {"summary": "Gameweek 12 is a double for every team, and the deadline is Friday. Rogers and Haaland are both injured and score nothing, so this week is about replacing them. You have 1 free transfer and 30 in the bank.", "transfers": "Make two transfers. Transfer Rogers (8.3m) for Tavernier (6.7m). He is nailed on with a high goal threat, and Onze predicts 9.5 pts. Then transfer Haaland (15.8m) for Barry (5.7m). He is also nailed on with a high goal threat, and Onze predicts 8.6 pts. The second move costs a 4-point hit, and it's worth taking. Both of your injured players would score nothing, and after the hit the pair is worth about 14 more points this week. Looking further ahead, Henderson to B.Fernandes in GW13 is on the radar.", "captaincy": "Captain Gabriel. Onze predicts 9.5 pts, the highest in your team, and he is nailed on with a good clean sheet chance.
